Gamification.title: Why does a game hold attention better than a banner?
Gamification.intro: Challenges, choices and rewards invite people to take part. The same approach can introduce a brand, teach a subject or bring a celebration to life.

items.title: Events
items.text: Turn your booth into an interactive activation. Rankings and sign-ups for interested participants can be part of the game.

items.title: Businesses
items.text: Present training, internal campaigns and customer activities as experiences people are invited to join.

items.title: Education
items.text: Help students practice through play on a phone or computer, without installing an app.

items.title: Parties
items.text: Gender reveals, birthdays or bridal parties: entertain guests and reveal the prize on the spot.

items.title: Businesses and schools
items.text: Have a service or subject that could use an interactive experience? I can build ideas such as a tooth-brushing game for a dental office or a music app for lessons.

Offer.title: 3 ways to bring a game to your project

items.title: A mini-game with your brand
items.text: Choose a ready-made base, such as roulette, Flappy Bird or Memory, then customize its look, colors and prizes for your campaign.

items.title: Custom-built game
items.text: We start with your business goal, then design, build and publish an experience made for your idea.

items.title: Online campaign with a game
items.text: Bring your campaign and game together on a web page. Sign-ups and rankings can be included to fit the goal and scope.

About.title: Who is behind it
About.intro: One developer follows each stage — design, programming, pixel art, music and publishing. You work directly with the person building your game, with fewer hand-offs and faster decisions. I'm Lucas Zaranza (Zazá), a fullstack developer with over 10 years of professional experience bringing games and web together.

CookieConsent.title: Cookies and privacy
CookieConsent.description: We use optional cookies for analytics, advertising, and YouTube videos. You choose what to allow.
CookieConsent.settingsIntro: Optional categories are off by default. Your choice is saved in this browser for up to 180 days and can be changed later.
CookieConsent.necessaryDescription: Stores your consent choice in this browser so your preferences can be remembered.
CookieConsent.analyticsDescription: Measures visits and interactions such as calls to action, contact clicks, demo opens, and video progress to understand page performance.
CookieConsent.marketingDescription: Measures advertising results and conversions and may help build remarketing audiences.
CookieConsent.mediaDescription: Loads YouTube thumbnails, player resources, and videos when you choose to watch a demo.

Privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
Privacy.intro: This notice explains which usage data may be measured on the Zaza Games landing page and how you can control cookies and similar technologies.
Privacy.controllerText: This page is maintained by Lucas Zaranza, who is responsible for Zaza Games. For privacy questions or requests, email
Privacy.eventsText: When you allow analytics or advertising, the page may send page views and UTM campaign parameters; advertising consent also allows ad click identifiers. It may measure CTA and contact clicks, the selected contact method, demo opens, video starts, and video progress milestones (25%, 50%, 75%, and completion). Other URL parameters are removed before the page location is sent, and the prefilled WhatsApp message content is not sent through these events.
Privacy.necessaryText: Stores your consent choice in this browser for up to 180 days. It is not used for advertising or behavior measurement.
Privacy.analyticsText: Helps us understand visits and interactions with the page, such as CTAs, contacts, and demos. This category stays off until you allow it.
Privacy.marketingTitle: Advertising — Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel and Google Ads
Privacy.marketingText: May measure campaign conversions and create or evaluate advertising and remarketing audiences. This category stays off until you allow it.
Privacy.mediaText: Allows YouTube thumbnails, the player, and hosted videos to load. Without this permission, remote video and thumbnail requests are blocked. You can change this choice in cookie settings.
Privacy.storageText: Your consent preference is stored in your browser's local storage for up to 180 days. Cookies and identifiers set by third-party tools depend on the tags and retention periods configured in each platform. Those periods can change, so also review the providers' notices and the settings published in Tag Manager.
Privacy.providersText: Tools enabled after your permission may receive technical browser data such as IP address, device information, and authorized events. Review each provider's notice:
Privacy.rightsText: You can reject optional categories or change/revoke your choice at any time using “Cookie settings” in the footer. To exercise rights related to your personal data or ask a question, contact lucaszaranza@gmail.com.
